description: Rewrites eat/drink medicine calques to take medicine only when eat/drink directly governs a medicine-object whitelist.
fp_risk_note: Medium risk. Drink and eat are correct with food/liquids, and medicine sentences can include food/water plus medicine. V1 only rewrites eat/drink directly governing a medicine-object whitelist.

positive.notes: Drink directly governs medicine, so English uses take.
Ate directly governs a quantified medicine object.
Drinks directly governs antibiotics and preserves the frequency phrase.

positive.input: I eat a tablet of medicine.
positive.expectedCorrection: I take a tablet of medicine.
positive.notes: Tablet is still treated as medicine when followed by an explicit medicine tail.

negative.notes: Drink directly governs water, not medicine.
Eat does not directly govern a medicine object.
Confusable: 'candy' is a real edible object (not in the medicine whitelist), so 'eat' is correct and the rule abstains.
Confusable: idiom 'eat your words' — object is not a medicine noun, so the rule abstains.

negative.input: I eat a tablet of chocolate.
negative.expectedCorrection: I eat a tablet of chocolate.
negative.notes: Confusable: tablet can be confection when followed by 'of chocolate', so the rule abstains.
